title: Magneto Developer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Magento Developer based in Turkey. As a Magento Developer, you will contribute to the development, customization, and maintenance of e-commerce websites built on Magento 2. In this remote, part-time role, you will work on project-based assignments or monthly contracts, helping deliver reliable, secure, and high-performing online shopping experiences. You will customize storefronts, develop modules, integrate third-party services, and resolve technical issues to ensure seamless website functionality. Working with a range of web technologies, you will help improve website performance, usability, and security while meeting project requirements. You will collaborate with team members to deliver quality solutions within agreed timelines and adapt to evolving business needs. This opportunity is ideal for a developer with a solid foundation in Magento 2 who values flexible working arrangements and hands-on experience with e-commerce projects. Accountabilities Develop, customize, and maintain e-commerce websites using Magento 2, ensuring functionality, reliability, and a smooth user experience. Customize Magento themes, modules, extensions, and storefront features to meet specific project and business requirements. Integrate third-party APIs, payment gateways, shipping services, and other external tools to extend website capabilities. Troubleshoot technical issues, identify bugs, implement fixes, and maintain the stability of e-commerce platforms. Optimize website performance, loading speed, and overall functionality to support efficient and responsive online shopping experiences. Write, test, and maintain code using PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and XML. Implement security updates, apply maintenance fixes, and follow appropriate development practices to help protect websites and customer data. Collaborate with team members to clarify requirements, provide technical updates, and deliver project milestones within agreed deadlines. Support ongoing improvements and technical enhancements based on project priorities and evolving business needs. Requirements Between one and three years of hands-on experience in Magento 2 development, customization, and maintenance. Practical knowledge of PHP and MySQL, with the ability to develop and troubleshoot e-commerce functionality. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and XML for storefront customization and web development. Experience customizing Magento themes, modules, extensions, and storefront components. Understanding of third-party API integrations, payment gateway configurations, and shipping service integrations. Ability to identify and resolve technical issues, debug code, and improve website performance. Awareness of website security practices, software updates, and ongoing e-commerce platform maintenance. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to producing clean, reliable, and maintainable code. Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to understand project requirements and work independently when needed. Good time management skills and the ability to deliver assigned tasks within agreed timelines in a remote working environment. Availability for part-time contractual work, with flexibility to support project-based or monthly engagements. Immediate availability is preferred. Benefits Remote work: Work from anywhere, subject to the engagement requirements. Part-time flexibility: Balance professional commitments with flexible working hours based on project needs. Contractual engagement: Choose from project-based assignments or monthly contract arrangements, depending on business requirements. Experience-based compensation: Compensation is determined by your experience, technical expertise, and the scope of work. Practical development experience: Work on real-world Magento 2 e-commerce projects and strengthen your technical skills. Technical growth: Gain further experience in e-commerce customization, third-party integrations, troubleshooting, and website optimization. Collaborative environment: Work with a team to deliver technical solutions and contribute to ongoing project improvements. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Consulente SAP FI
description: SAP FI Danışmanı (Freelance / Serbest Çalışan) AGAP2 Italia , uluslararası bir müşterimizin projesinde görev almak üzere, Türkçe bilen deneyimli bir SAP FI Danışmanı aramaktadır. Aranan Nitelikler SAP FI (Financial Accounting) alanında en az 3 yıl deneyim. SAP FI modülünün temel süreçlerine hâkimiyet: General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR) ve Asset Accounting (AA). SAP FI modülünün yapılandırılması ve özelleştirilmesi konusunda deneyim. Finansal ve muhasebesel iş süreçleri hakkında güçlü bilgi. Fonksiyonel gereksinim analizi, sorun giderme ve kullanıcı desteği konularında deneyim. İleri düzeyde Türkçe bilgisi (zorunlu). İyi düzeyde İngilizce bilgisi. SAP S/4HANA deneyimi tercih sebebidir. Görev ve Sorumluluklar SAP ortamında finansal ve muhasebesel süreçlerin analizi ve yönetimi. SAP FI modülünün yapılandırılması, bakımı ve optimizasyonu. İş gereksinimlerinin toplanması ve fonksiyonel çözümlerin geliştirilmesi. Test, uygulama ve canlıya geçiş sonrası destek süreçlerinde aktif rol alınması. Uluslararası ekipler ve Türkçe konuşan paydaşlarla koordinasyon. Fonksiyonel dokümantasyon hazırlanması ve son kullanıcı desteği sağlanması. Çalışma Koşulları Çalışma şekli: Yalnızca Freelance / Serbest Meslek (İtalya'da Partita IVA sahibi olan profesyoneller). Deneyim seviyesi: Orta / Kıdemli (Middle / Senior). Zorunlu dil: Akıcı Türkçe. Başlangıç tarihi: Karşılıklı olarak belirlenecektir. Proje süresi: Belirlenecektir. Günlük ücret: Deneyime göre değerlendirilecektir. Başvuru İlgilenen adayların güncel özgeçmişlerini, işe başlama uygunluk durumlarını, günlük ücret beklentilerini ve Türkçe dil seviyelerini paylaşmaları rica olunur. Önemli: Bu pozisyon yalnızca Partita IVA kapsamında bağımsız danışman olarak çalışabilecek profesyonellere yöneliktir. Bordrolu veya sürekli iş sözleşmesi kapsamında istihdam öngörülmemektedir.

title: Technical Analyst-Anti Money Laundering Team
description: Who we are? With offices in Kuwait City, Baku, Dubai, and Istanbul, we are providing services across 32 countries from Hong Kong to the UK. Since 2010, Fineksus has been recognized by the SWIFT Partner Management for its Service Delivery Centre in implementing, integrating, and upgrading services for SWIFT products and solutions. Since 2018, Fineksus has also been compliant with the Shared Infrastructure Programme required by SWIFT. In 2025, we joined the cleversoft group—a leading German software company—strengthening our presence in the global Fintech and RegTech space. We leverage machine learning and develop new financial crime detection techniques to ensure more efficient and effective AML compliance. Fineksus is the smart choice for financial institutions aiming to adapt to the ever-increasing demands of compliance in the financial industry. We are looking for a new teammate to join our Test&Analysis Team on AML (Anti-Money Laundering) domain. This hybrid role requires working 2 days per week in the office and reports to the Senior Manager of Test & Analysis. How will be your day like? · Conduct business analysis activities for AML-based projects · Analyze business requirements and prepare functional and technical requirement documents · Coordinate between business units, clients, compliance teams, and technical teams (development, testing) · Prepare analysis and documentation for integration scenarios (REST, SOAP, MQ, file, DB, etc.) · Work on AML modules such as transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, customer risk scoring, case management, and regulatory reporting ·  Develop improvement suggestions for existing AML systems and operational processes ·  Utilize AI-powered tools effectively in analysis processes to enhance efficiency and quality ·  Support creation of test scenarios and actively support UAT processes ·   Provide guidance to junior analysts when necessary Required Skills and Qualifications ·   At least 2 years of business analysis experience (preferably in AML, compliance, banking, or financial systems projects) · Strong analytical thinking and documentation skills · Familiarity with analysis techniques such as UML, BPMN, use case, sequence diagrams · Understanding of testing and UAT processes · Ability to use AI-based tools effectively for requirement analysis, documentation, and test scenario generation · Strong communication and teamwork skills · Proficiency in written and spoken English · Knowledge of AML and compliance processes (Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, KYC, Customer Risk Assessment, etc.) is preffered ·  Familiarity with international AML regulations and standards would be beneficial ·  Experience in fintech or banking projects is an advantage ·  Experience with Web Service API integrations and database technologies (SQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL) is a plus · Experience with AML solutions such as alert management, case management, screening, and reporting systems would be beneficial ·  Experience working with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Azure DevOps is an advantage Supporting Skills · Analytical Thinking: Analyzes complex problems and produces clear, structured solutions · Comprehensive Approach : Evaluates system-wide impacts of changes across processes and integrations · Communication: Communicates technical and business topics clearly to diverse stakeholders · Agility: Adapts quickly to changing requirements and priorities · Persuasion: Effectively influences stakeholders by clearly presenting analysis and solution options · Proactivity: Anticipates risks early and takes initiative to address them · Teamwork: Collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams What’s in it for you? At Fineksus, we believe that work should enrich your life—not just fill your calendar. That’s why we offer a variety of benefits designed to support your well-being, growth, and happiness: · Subsidized Meals: Enjoy subsidized meals to fuel your workday. · Transportation Fee : We've got you covered, whether it's your daily commute or business travel. · Healthcare Coverage : Your health matters. We provide comprehensive private health insurance plans. · Communication Allowance: Stay connected with a dedicated mobile line. · Recognition Rewards : Performance-based bonuses to acknowledge your contributions. · Gift Card (Corporate) : Each year, we provide gift cards to our employees, allowing them to purchase their needs. · Birthday Leave Flexibility : We celebrate you! Enjoy flexible time off around your birthday to make the most of your special day. · Technical Training: Stay ahead with access to technical training programs designed to enhance your skills and knowledge. · Special Occasion Gifts : Thoughtful surprises await you on special days—because we care about the moments that matter. · Social Events : From happy hours and company picnics to year-end parties and special gatherings—we love creating memorable moments together. These events are our way of staying connected, having fun, and celebrating team spirit.

title: Telecomm. Systems SW Engineer
description: Vega Networks is an exciting and dynamic organization that is shaping the future of broadband and wireless network connectivity. We are seeking an engineer with a strong Telecommunications and Wi-Fi background who is passionate about wireless networking technologies. You will contribute to the design, analysis, validation, testing, and troubleshooting of Wi-Fi systems while also participating in the development of tools and software used to monitor, diagnose, and optimize Wi-Fi networks. Good software development skills are important, but strong knowledge of Wi-Fi technologies and wireless networking concepts is our primary focus. You will work closely with our international engineering team and should be comfortable working independently with minimal supervision. Education: B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Desired Experience and Qualifications include all or some of: Strong academic or professional background in Telecommunications, Wireless Communications, or Wi-Fi technologies . Minimum 5 years of overall professional experience is required Hands-on software development experience (e.g., Java, C#, or Python) is required; however, strong Telecommunications and Wi-Fi domain knowledge will be given higher priority. Strong knowledge of IEEE 802.11 (Wi-Fi) technologies , protocols, and wireless networking concepts is highly preferred. Experience with Wi-Fi system validation , Systems QA , interoperability testing, or Wi-Fi test automation is highly desirable. Strong knowledge of IEEE 802.11 (Wi-Fi 5/6/6E/7), roaming, Multi-AP, MLO, and wireless performance optimization is highly preferred. Strong analytical skills, capable of investigating and troubleshooting issues based on data Experience in algorithm analysis Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools (e.g. codex, Claude Code) is desirable. Familiarity with Linux (as user) as well as programming in scripting languages like Python. Familiarity with SQL Familiarity with MongoDB Familiarity with version control systems, such as git Familiarity with Machine Learning concepts Additional Desired Skills or Ability to Learn: Background in communications, such as an EE or EECS major is preferred Experience in data mining, statistical inference, or deep learning techniques is preferred Proficiency in SQL scripting for data manipulation is preferred Hands-on experience with machine learning packages is preferred Perks: We offer competitive salaries based on USD Full remote working is optional Please send your CV to career@veganetworks.net if interested
